Definition: properly, a combination or gathering, i.e. of watery clouds
BiblicalUsage: This is a gathering or mass of watery clouds, and David uses it in his song of deliverance when God comes down wrapped in darkness, dark waters and thick clouds of the skies. The word paints the storm God rides in to rescue.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God is not kept out by the storm clouds; He comes through them to deliver His people.
